invariants: Only a named initializer may create fresh_source_tree_only.
A successor must copy source_tree_scope, state_origin and root_entry_id from its admitted parent; a branch projector cannot upgrade them.
Every terminal-first receipt is bound to the exact node and ordered policy version.
A target-derived universal raw word is analysis evidence until this receipt binds it to an admitted source.
activation_gates: Versioned source-receipt schema and independent validator.
State identity includes immutable source-scope fields or an equivalently replayed parent binding.
One registered producer binds the receipt to a concrete source and target owner.
Independent E1-E4 validator and parent-to-final T5 ticket.
Target re-entry through the shared runtime.
